reviewedBy: Dr. A. Sharma (Chief Medical Officer, Emergency & Trauma)
disclaimer: Non-triage safety net: Absence of a flag does NOT rule out a medical emergency. Staff must always exercise independent clinical judgment.

rules.name: Possible Acute Coronary Syndrome
rules.description: Severe chest pain combined with shortness of breath, diaphoresis, or pain radiating to left arm/jaw.
rules.patientAlertMessage: URGENT: Please inform the hospital reception or emergency desk immediately for urgent chest evaluation.

rules.name: Possible Acute Stroke (FAST Criteria)
rules.description: Sudden onset of facial weakness, arm/leg weakness, slurred speech, or acute loss of vision.
rules.patientAlertMessage: URGENT: Neurological symptom detected. Please notify hospital staff immediately for fast-track evaluation.

rules.name: Acute Severe Respiratory Distress
rules.description: Severe breathlessness, inability to speak full sentences, stridor, or cyanosis.
rules.patientAlertMessage: URGENT: Severe breathing difficulty detected. Please alert triage staff immediately for oxygen support.

rules.name: Active Uncontrolled Hemorrhage
rules.description: Severe continuous bleeding, hematemesis (vomiting blood), or hemoptysis (coughing blood).
rules.patientAlertMessage: URGENT: Severe bleeding detected. Please proceed to the emergency treatment room immediately.

rules.name: Infant High Fever / Lethargy (<3 months)
rules.description: Infant under 3 months with temperature >= 38C (100.4F), extreme lethargy, or convulsions.
rules.patientAlertMessage: URGENT: High infant fever detected. Please notify pediatric OPD/emergency staff without delay.

rules.name: Suspected Anaphylaxis
rules.description: Throat tightness, facial swelling, hives, and wheezing following food, insect sting, or drug exposure.
rules.patientAlertMessage: URGENT: Potential severe allergic reaction detected. Please alert the nursing station immediately.
